name: Kuki Seishirou
source:
He is a teacher at Fuyuka Academy (冬華学園) and advisor of the school's Knights.
He is popular among students because of his soft and friendly personality.

Although he is the advisor of the school's Knights, he does not give any particular advice to the Knights, but rather respects the independence of the students.
